Daily challenges.Title: Morning gratitude
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic:
أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَٰذَا الْيَوْمِ، وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَٰذَا الْيَوْمِ، وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
Daily challenges.Translation:
We have entered a new morning and with it all dominion belongs to Allah and all praise is due to Allah
There is no god but Allah alone without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise and He is over all things capable
My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the difficulties of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the Hellfire and the punishment of the grave
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal mulku lillahi wal hamdu lillah la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir. Rabbi asaluka khayra ma fi hadha al-yawm wa khayra ma ba'dahu wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadha al-yawm wa sharri ma ba'dahu. Rabbi a'udhu bika minal kasali wa su'il kibar. Rabbi a'udhu bika min adhabin fin-nar wa adhabin fil-qabr.

Daily challenges.Title: Infinite Praiser
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
Daily challenges.Translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him by the number of His creation, by His pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the ink of His words.
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi adada khalqihi wa rida nafsihi wa zinata arshihi wa midada kalimatihi

Daily challenges.Title: Morning Reliance
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
Daily challenges.Translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning, and by You we enter the evening, by You we live, and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna wa bika nahya wa bika namut wa ilaykan-nushoor

Daily challenges.Title: Affirmation of Faith
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَىٰ فِطْرَةِ الإِسْلَامِ، وَكَلِمَةِ الإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَىٰ دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَىٰ مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
Daily challenges.Translation: We have entered the morning upon the natural religion of Islam, the word of sincere devotion (Shahadah), the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the way of our father Abraham, who was upright and a Muslim, and was not of those who associate others with Allah.
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Asbahna ala fitratil-Islam wa kalimatil-ikhlas wa ala dini nabiyyina Muhammad sallallahu alayhi wa sallam wa ala millati abina Ibrahim hanifan Musliman wa ma kana min al-mushrikeen

Daily challenges.Title: Tawheed and Protection
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِي سُوءًا، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَىٰ مُسْلِمٍ
Daily challenges.Translation: O Allah Creator of the heavens and the earth Knower of the unseen and the seen there is no god but You Lord and Owner of everything I seek refuge in You from the evil of myself from the evil of Shaytan and his traps and from bringing harm upon myself or dragging it onto another Muslim
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Allahumma fatiras samawati wal ard ʿalimal ghaybi wash shahadah la ilaha illa anta rabbakulli shay’in wa malikahu aʿudhu bika min sharri nafsi wa min sharri ash shaytani wa shirkih wa an aqtarifa ʿala nafsi su’an aw ajurrahu ila muslim

Daily challenges.Title: Dua for Contentment
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللّٰهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا
Daily challenges.Translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet.
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Raditu billahi rabban wa bil-islami dinan wa bi-Muhammadin nabiyyan

Daily challenges.Title: Protection Dua
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
Daily challenges.Translation: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru maasmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwa as-sami'ul alim

Daily challenges.Title: Wellbeing & Health
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
Daily challenges.Translation: O Allah, grant well-being to my body. O Allah, grant well-being to my hearing. O Allah, grant well-being to my sight. There is no deity but You.
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Allahumma aafini fi badani Allahumma aafini fi sam'i Allahumma aafini fi basari la ilaha illa anta

Daily challenges.Title: Dua for Forgiveness
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
Daily challenges.Translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. There is no deity except You.
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr wa a'udhu bika min adhabil-qabr la ilaha illa anta

Daily challenges.Title: Total dependence on Allah
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَىٰ نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
Daily challenges.Translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help, rectify for me all of my affairs, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum birahmatika astagheeth aslih li sha'ni kullah wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata ayn

Daily challenges.Title: Sayyid ul Astaghfar
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
Daily challenges.Translation: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I admit to You Your blessings upon me, and I admit to You my sins, so forgive me, for surely no one forgives sins except You.
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta khalaqtani wa ana abduk wa ana ala ahdika wa wa'dika ma ista'ta't a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't aboo'u laka bini'matika alayya wa aboo'u bidhanbi faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfiru adh-dhunuba illa anta

Daily challenges.Title: Protection from harm
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
Daily challenges.Translation: O Allah I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter O Allah I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs and my family and my wealth O Allah conceal my faults and calm my fears O Allah protect me from in front of me and from behind me and from my right and from my left and from above me and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being taken unaware from beneath me
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Allahumma inni as’aluka al-afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah Allahumma inni as’aluka al-afwa wal-afiyah fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali Allahumma astur ‘awrati wa amin raw‘ati Allahumma ihfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfī wa ‘an yamini wa ‘an shimali wa min fawqi wa a‘udhu bi ‘azamatika an ughtala min tahti

Daily challenges.Title: Remembrance
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Daily challenges.Translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion, and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things capable.
Daily challenges.Transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir

Daily challenges.Title: Lightest yet Heaviest
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
Daily challenges.Translation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi

Daily challenges.Title: Dhikr: Astaghfirullah
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
Daily challenges.Translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Astaghfirullāh

Daily challenges.Title: Evening gratitude
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic:
اللَّهُمَّ أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ، وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ، وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
Daily challenges.Translation: O Allah, we have entered the evening and so has the dominion, all belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone without partner. To Him belongs the kingdom and to Him belongs the praise, and He is over all things capable. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it. And I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the hardships of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the Fire and the punishment of the grave.
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Allahumma amsayna wa amsal mulku lillah walhamdu lillah. La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah. Lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir. Rabbi asaluka khayra ma fi hadhihi al-laylah wa khayra ma ba'daha. Wa a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhihi al-laylah wa sharri ma ba'daha. Rabbi a'udhu bika minal kasal wa su'il kibar. Rabbi a'udhu bika min adhabin fin-nar wa adhabin fil-qabr.

Daily challenges.Title: Ayat ul Kursi
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday

Daily challenges.Title: Evening Reliance
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
Daily challenges.Translation: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening and by Your leave we reach the morning. By Your leave we live and by Your leave we die. And to You is the return.
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna wa bika asbahna wa bika nahya wa bika namut wa ilaykal maseer.

Daily challenges.Title: Affirmation of Faith
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَىٰ فِطْرَةِ الإِسْلَامِ، وَكَلِمَةِ الإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَىٰ دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَىٰ مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
Daily challenges.Translation: We have entered the evening upon the natural religion of Islam, and the word of sincere devotion, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the way of our forefather Ibrahim, who was upright and a Muslim, and was not among the polytheists.
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Amsayna ala fitratil Islam wa kalimatil ikhlas wa ala deeni nabiyyina Muhammadin sallallahu alayhi wa sallam wa ala millati abina Ibrahima hanifan musliman wa ma kana minal mushrikeen.

Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday

Daily challenges.Transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru maasmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwa as-sami'ul alim

Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ

Daily challenges.Title: Evening Protection Duʿa
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
Daily challenges.Translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
Daily challenges.Transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahi tammati min sharri ma khalaq.

Daily challenges.Title: Wellbeing & Health
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
Daily challenges.Translation: O Allah, grant well-being to my body. O Allah, grant well-being to my hearing. O Allah, grant well-being to my sight. There is no deity but You.
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Allahumma aafini fi badani Allahumma aafini fi sam'i Allahumma aafini fi basari la ilaha illa anta

Daily challenges.Title: Total dependence on Allah
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَىٰ نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
Daily challenges.Translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help, rectify for me all of my affairs, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum birahmatika astagheeth aslih li sha'ni kullah wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata ayn

Daily challenges.Title: Sayyid ul Astaghfar
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
Daily challenges.Translation: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I admit to You Your blessings upon me, and I admit to You my sins, so forgive me, for surely no one forgives sins except You.
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta khalaqtani wa ana abduk wa ana ala ahdika wa wa'dika ma ista'ta't a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't aboo'u laka bini'matika alayya wa aboo'u bidhanbi faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfiru adh-dhunuba illa anta

Daily challenges.Title: Protection from harm
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
Daily challenges.Translation: O Allah I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter O Allah I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs and my family and my wealth O Allah conceal my faults and calm my fears O Allah protect me from in front of me and from behind me and from my right and from my left and from above me and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being taken unaware from beneath me
Daily challenges.Transliteration: Allahumma inni as’aluka al-afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah Allahumma inni as’aluka al-afwa wal-afiyah fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali Allahumma astur ‘awrati wa amin raw‘ati Allahumma ihfazni min bayni yadayya wa min khalfī wa ‘an yamini wa ‘an shimali wa min fawqi wa a‘udhu bi ‘azamatika an ughtala min tahti

Daily challenges.Title: Remembrance
Daily challenges.day: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday
Daily challenges.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Daily challenges.Translation: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion, and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things capable.
Daily challenges.Transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
